title: MZ how to make a game keyboard only

posts.author: BirdLord
posts.body: I don't want my game to rely on mouse control so I want to remove that, and also the main menu & the rest of the game should be controlled using keyboard keys. Is there a plugin that can do that?

posts.author: BirdLord
caethyril
posts.body:
No, it's a plugin: an extra script file that you select in the Plugin Manager, which loads after the core scripts. Plugins modify the game engine in certain ways, like disabling touch input.
To convert plaintext to a plugin:
Copy + paste the code into a text editor (e.g. Notepad).
File > Save As:
File Type: All Files
Filename: whatever
.js
(This works because .js files are plaintext.)
Import that file as a plugin:
Place the file in your project's
js/plugins
subfolder.
In RPG Maker, open the Plugin Manager via the Tools menu (or by pressing F10).
Double-click an empty row to add a new plugin.
Select the plugin and click OK.
Save your project to apply Plugin Manager changes.
Test!
I've attached the code as a plugin file so you can skip steps 1 & 2 this time~
